# SayDone C2 authoring context

Primary authoring source is complete C2 text. JSON is a deterministic machine snapshot.

Read progressively:
1. AI_START_HERE.md
2. docs/authoring/c2/LANGUAGE.md
3. docs/authoring/c2/CORE_OPERATIONS.md
4. docs/authoring/c2/DATA_AND_INTEGRATIONS.md when data, HTTP, timers, or subflows are needed
5. docs/authoring/c2/ROUTING.md when inputs or external routes are needed
6. docs/authoring/c2/ACCEPTANCE_AND_LIFECYCLE.md when validating or replacing a revision
7. docs/authoring/providers/telegram.md only for Telegram-specific facts
8. docs/authoring/c2/examples/README.md for production-valid examples

Do not use legacy/v1-json for new C2 revisions. It is historical and migration reference only.
